summary.title: Admin panel
summary.emptyText: No rentals start or end today, no quote requests are waiting, and there are no new reservations in the last 7 days.
summary.errorTitle: The summary could not be loaded
summary.errorText: Try again in a few seconds.

table.errorTitle: The list could not be loaded
table.errorText: Try again in a few seconds.

stale.title: This record changed while you were editing it
stale.text: What you entered is kept. Load the current record and apply your changes again.

unsaved.title: You have unsaved changes
unsaved.text: If you leave this page, what you entered is lost.

file.tooLarge: The file is larger than {size} MB.
file.wrongType: This file type is not accepted.

dev.title: Panel components
dev.intro: The shared components of the admin panel. Open in development only.
dev.emptyText: The first booking will show up here.
dev.confirmText: A closed branch is not shown on the site. You can reopen it at any time.
dev.toastFailed: It could not be saved. Try again.
dev.bilingualHint: Leave one empty and press Save: the missing language is marked.
dev.missingText: Enter the text in this language.

promoCodes.title: Campaign codes
promoCodes.intro: The discount codes entered on the booking summary. A code you add can be used at once.
promoCodes.newIntro: As soon as the code is created it can be used on the booking summary.
promoCodes.detailIntro: Used in {used} bookings so far. Created on {created}.
promoCodes.emptyText: Add the first one; it can be used on the booking summary at once.
promoCodes.emptyFilteredText: Try removing the filter or searching for another code.
promoCodes.loadErrorTitle: The codes could not be loaded
promoCodes.loadErrorText: Try again in a few seconds.

fields.codeHint: Letters and digits, 3 to 20 characters. Made upper case; it cannot be changed later.
fields.codeFixed: The name of a code cannot be changed; make a new code for another name.
fields.percentHint: A number from 1 to 90. It comes off the car and extras together.
fields.validUntilHint: This day included. If empty, no end date. Istanbul time.
fields.maxRedemptionsHint: How many bookings can use the code. If empty, no limit.
fields.maxRedemptionsHintUsed: If empty, no limit. Used in {used} bookings so far; the limit cannot be lower.
fields.oncePerUser: Each account can use the code only once
fields.active: Code is on (when off, it is applied to no booking)

errors.code: Enter a code of 3 to 20 characters, letters and digits only.
errors.percent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 90.
errors.validUntil: The last day cannot be before the first day.
errors.dateRange: The last day must be after the first day.
errors.maxRedemptions: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
errors.belowUsage: The limit cannot be lower than the uses so far ({used}).
errors.taken: A code with this name already exists.
errors.generic: This was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This code no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errors.unavailable: It could not be saved. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.staleShort: Someone else changed this code in the meantime. The current version was loaded; try again.

actions.title: Switch off or delete the code
actions.usedText: This code was used in {used} bookings. Switched off, it is applied to no new booking and the old ones do not change.
actions.unusedText: This code was never used in a booking; you can delete it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the code {code}?
deleteDialog.text: A deleted code cannot be brought back and is no longer applied on the booking summary.

deactivateDialog.title: Switch off the code {code}?
deactivateDialog.text: A code that is off is applied to no new booking. The amount of existing bookings does not change. You can switch it on again at any time.

inUseDialog.title: {code} cannot be deleted
inUseDialog.text: {code} was used in at least one booking, and the past records carry its name. Instead of deleting it you can switch it off: it is applied to no new booking and the old ones do not change.

branches.title: Branches
branches.intro: The branches shown on the site, in the search form and on the map. A branch you add appears at once; a branch you close is shown nowhere.
branches.newIntro: As soon as the branch is created it shows on the Branches page, in the search form and on the map. A branch with no cars says "no cars available" in the search; its cars are added later.
branches.emptyText: Add the first branch; it shows on the site at once.
branches.emptyFilteredText: Try removing the filters or searching for something else.
branches.loadErrorTitle: The branches could not be loaded
branches.loadErrorText: Try again in a few seconds.

fields.name: Branch name
fields.kindHint: An airport desk or a city office. The filter on the Branches page works by it.
fields.latitudeHint: Example: 39.9179. In Türkiye it is between 36 and 42.
fields.longitudeHint: Example: 32.8627. In Türkiye it is between 26 and 45.
fields.seeOnMap: See the point on a map (opens in a new tab)

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.hint: The opening and closing time of each day; tick "Closed" for a day the branch is shut.

errors.name: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.
errors.city: Choose a city from the list.
errors.latitude: Enter a latitude between 36 and 42 (example: 39.9179). Latitude and longitude may be swapped.
errors.hours: The opening time has to be before the closing time, or tick the day as closed.
errors.generic: This was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This branch no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errors.unavailable: It could not be saved. Try again in a few seconds.

actions.title: Close or reopen the branch
actions.openText: A closed branch is shown nowhere on the site (search, list, map) and takes no new bookings. Past bookings keep its name. A branch is never deleted; you can open it again at any time.
actions.closedText: This branch is closed: it is not on the site and takes no new bookings. Open it again and it comes back as it was.
actions.blockedTitle: This branch cannot be closed now
actions.blockedText: These have to finish first, or be moved to another branch:

usage.reservations: {count, plural, one {# booking to come (starting at this branch or returning here)} other {# bookings to come (starting at this branch or returning here)}}
usage.holds: {count, plural, one {# running car hold (lasts 15 minutes at most)} other {# running car holds (last 15 minutes at most)}}
usage.vehicles: {count, plural, one {# car that is on (move it to another branch or remove it)} other {# cars that are on (move them to another branch or remove them)}}

closeDialog.title: Close {name}?
closeDialog.text: The branch disappears from the site, the search and the map and takes no new bookings. Past bookings keep its name. You can open it again.
